F1.evidence: Instagram publishes named roles (--primary-text, --secondary-text, --placeholder-text, --divider, --surface-background) and a spectrum on about.instagram.com, not a 10-step ramp per hue. core.color.neutral is a short ramp synthesised from those named roles.

F2.evidence: Page and surface are tokenised from --surface-background and --card-background. Popover, comment and deemphasized washes are tokenised. A scrim role is not a named token; the profile-gate overlay is in the screenshot only.

F3.evidence: Primary, secondary, muted, disabled, inverse, on-accent and link are tokenised in both themes from --primary-text, --secondary-text, --placeholder-text, --disabled-text, --inverse-text, --primary-button-text and --secondary-button-text.

F4.evidence: Default (--divider), focus (--focus-ring-blue) and focused (--border-focused) are tokenised. A strong border role is not published as its own name.

F5.evidence: Default and pressed are declared (--primary-button-background, --primary-button-pressed). Hover of the login pill does not repaint because the control is disabled until a field has a value. The about CTA hover is cropped.

F6.evidence: Positive, negative, warning and info fills are declared and tokenised. Borders and on-status text are not a complete set, and no status control was mounted signed out.

F7.evidence: Every semantic role written for light has a dark counterpart, resolved by forcing __ig-dark-mode on the login wall. The form column itself stays light under that class; the README records that split.

F8.evidence: The --system-N scale is 13 sizes with line heights, and four families have fallback stacks. Named roles (display, heading, body, label, caption) are not published as a separate type ramp; the system sizes stand in for them.

F9.evidence: core.spacing is a derived 4px scale. Instagram does not publish a space scale as custom properties. The README marks it derived.

F10.evidence: Named radii are tokenised: button 4px, input 6px, dialog 8px, modal 12px, igds dialog 24px, menu 20px, chat bubble 18px. The 22px login pill is measured on the crop and named in components.md.

F11.evidence: Control heights are measured: login pill 44px, explore Log in 32px, dialog Sign up 42px, help search 72px, birthday select 60px. No declared icon-size scale, and the focus ring offset is not a separate token.

F12.evidence: --shadow-base and --shadow-elevated are declared and multi-layer, so they were not tokenised as DTCG shadows. The signed-out chrome is mostly flat. The dialog elevation is in the screenshot, not a shadow token.

F13.evidence: Named durations (--fds-duration-extra-extra-short-in through extra-long) and three easings are tokenised. The probe's reduce verdict is partial: the login wall and signup form ignore reduced motion, about.instagram.com is partial. Stylesheet lists were cut at 400, recorded on core.motion.$extensions.

F14.evidence: Desktop 1440 and phone 390 are captured. about.instagram.com declares width bands (--about-ig-phone-width-max 767px, tablet 768-1439, desktop-small 1440). No grid-column or z-index scale was extracted.

C1.evidence: Present and captured: button, link, text field, select, dialog, card, list row, table. Declared but not cropped: badge. Not present signed out: icon button, text area, checkbox, radio, switch, tabs, tooltip, toast, avatar. Menu (about hamburger) was not opened. That is 8 of 19.

C2.evidence: Hover is cropped for the login pill (no repaint, the control is disabled) and the about CTA. Focus is cropped for the username field. Disabled is the login pill at rest. Pressed, loading and error were not provoked because a press submits.

C3.evidence: The username field's focus ring is cropped. The login pill was not given keyboard focus as a separate crop because it is disabled. Focus tokens exist (--focus-ring-blue, --border-focused).

C4.evidence: components.md names token paths next to the measured hex and pixel values so a reader can check the crop. It is not token-only.

P1.evidence: patterns.md covers the login wall, the signup column, password reset, the marketing page, help search, the locations directory and the profile-gate dialog. Empty, loading, error, destructive confirmation and post-submit feedback were not on the public pages. Onboarding stops at the unsubmitted signup form, and the phone path asks for a mobile number.

A1.evidence: icon.png is the 128px apple-touch icon. Fonts are named with system fallbacks; the proprietary files are not shipped. No standalone SVG icon set was indexed. The glyph is in the crops and is called out as artwork not to copy.

K1.evidence: The README says what was captured, how the values were read, what to distrust, and the signup and logged-in boundaries.
